name: Tripper Seyahat Ütüsü
issues: The folder contains photographs of two completely different products: Evia Holiday travel irons stored on warehouse shelves in 00000077.jpg, and an Arzum Tripper travel iron shown in 00000330.jpg.
Because there are two conflicting primary subjects across the reference files, no single primary product exists for this folder.
Model number EA-4603 on the Evia iron boxes is small and low-contrast, set to medium confidence.
Smartness SK-1079 Bluetooth scale boxes appear in the lower shelf background of 00000077.jpg.
verification_notes: Arzum'un Tripper serisi seyahat ütüsünün resmi model kodu AR690'dır.
Görsel denetim notlarında belirtilen ikinci ürün (Evia Holiday) haricinde, Arzum Tripper ürünü doğrulanarak model kodu güncellenmiştir.
